name: @omp-dev-team/datadog
description: Datadog observability for OMP via the Datadog 'pup' CLI — one broad skill that drives pup.
comment: Config-only plugin: install.sh/ps1 install the pup CLI (DataDog/pup) and set up auth. The single 'datadog' skill routes everything through pup so OMP's skill list isn't flooded by pup's ~30 embedded domain skills. --with-skills opts into `pup skills install pi`. Ships a path-inject extension (prepends ~/.local/bin to process.env.PATH at OMP startup, since OMP spawns bash non-login/non-interactive and never sources shell profiles — otherwise `pup`, landed in ~/.local/bin by install.sh's prebuilt-tarball fallback, is invisible to the bash tool even after a restart). install.sh mirrors extensions/ into ~/.omp/agent/extensions/datadog (OMP does not load extensions from marketplace cache installs).
